SELECT i.i_item_id,
       addr.ca_country,
       addr.ca_state,
       addr.ca_county,
       AVG(CAST(s.cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg1,
       AVG(CAST(s.cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg2,
       AVG(CAST(s.cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg3,
       AVG(CAST(s.cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg4,
       AVG(CAST(s.cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg5,
       AVG(CAST(cust.c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg6,
       AVG(CAST(cd1.cd_dep_count AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg7
FROM (
    SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
           cs.cs_item_sk,
           cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
           cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
           cs.cs_quantity,
           cs.cs_list_price,
           cs.cs_coupon_amt,
           cs.cs_sales_price,
           cs.cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales AS cs
    JOIN date_dim AS d
      ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
) AS s
JOIN (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk,
           cd_dep_count
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
) AS cd1
  ON s.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN item AS i
  ON s.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_birth_year,
           c.c_current_addr_sk
    FROM customer AS c
    JOIN (
        SELECT cd_demo_sk
        FROM customer_demographics
    ) AS cd2
      ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4)
) AS cust
  ON s.cs_bill_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT ca_address_sk,
           ca_country,
           ca_state,
           ca_county
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN','GA','MT','IN','CA')
) AS addr
  ON cust.c_current_addr_sk = addr.ca_address_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id,
         addr.ca_country,
         addr.ca_state,
         addr.ca_county
WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY addr.ca_country,
         addr.ca_state,
         addr.ca_county,
         i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100

raw_sql: select i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, avg( cast(cs_quantity as decimal(12,2))) agg1, avg( cast(cs_list_price as decimal(12,2))) agg2, avg( cast(cs_coupon_amt as decimal(12,2))) agg3, avg( cast(cs_sales_price as decimal(12,2))) agg4, avg( cast(cs_net_profit as decimal(12,2))) agg5, avg( cast(c_birth_year as decimal(12,2))) agg6, avg( cast(cd1.cd_dep_count as decimal(12,2))) agg7 from catalog_sales, customer_demographics cd1, customer_demographics cd2, customer, customer_address, date_dim, item where cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and cs_item_sk = i_item_sk and cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk and cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and cd1.cd_gender = 'F' and cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and c_birth_month in (1,3,7,11,10,4) and d_year = 2001 and ca_state in ('AL','MO','TN' ,'GA','MT','IN','CA') group by rollup (i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county) order by ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id limit 100
